summary_bullets: Stop errexit leaking from OOS-gate toggle blocks in ship-pr.sh so CI phases keep the script's set +e baseline
Harden local harness rc capture in _run_per_job_command_capture against future errexit leaks
Add errexit regression coverage and document the save/restore invariant in ship-pr.md
commit_message:
Fix ship-pr.sh undocumented exit 2 from errexit leak during local CI harness

Restore prior errexit state at the three OOS-gate toggle sites and make _run_per_job_command_capture errexit-safe so a failing local harness records its rc instead of aborting ship-pr.sh with an undocumented exit code.
